faq_paragraph: We've gathered the most frequently asked questions about MelliMusic to help you get started with ease.
faq_q1_answer: MelliMusic is a music platform where you can discover your musical identity, keep track of your most-listened-to artists and songs, customize your profile, and connect with other music lovers.
faq_q2_answer: It's a reflection of your music taste. MelliMusic brings together the music you listen to the most in one place, helping you understand and express who you are through music.
faq_q3_question: How does tracking my most-listened-to artists and songs work?
faq_q3_answer: You can see which artists and tracks are your favorites based on your listening habits, all organized in your profile so you can check them whenever you want.
faq_q4_answer: Absolutely! You can customize your musical profile to reflect your style and music taste, then share it with your friends.
faq_q5_question: Can I see what my friends listen to the most?
faq_q5_answer: Yes! In addition to sharing your own music taste, you can see what your friends listen to the most and connect with other music lovers in the community.
faq_q6_question: Is my profile public? What about my privacy?
faq_q6_answer: Public profiles respect each user's privacy settings. You decide what you want to share.
